about: How `boltbeam routing MODEL --engine E` gets a routing profile (roofline/routing_profile.py, boltbeam.routing_profile.v1) from each engine: adapter is the module that reads the engine's own record (profile(path, model, n_expert=, corpus=, tokens=)) and, when captures is true, also runs one (capture(...)); from says what --from takes. An engine with no row has no routing source BoltBeam can read; why says so.

strata.from: a --dump-routing trace (counts) or an --expert-profile file (a ranking only, a cross-check)

vllm.from: the vLLM prefill driver's JSON line with routing (--semantic-dispatch --capture)
